customer_name: China National Diving Team (中国国家跳水队)
business_problem: The China National Diving Team generated large volumes of short training videos but still relied on manual browsing and verbal coaching, making it hard to locate key frames quickly, quantify movement quality, or turn elite performance into reusable training knowledge.
solution_summary: Baidu AI Cloud built a '3D + AI' assisted training system for the China National Diving Team that combines cloud, edge, and on-site capture hardware with computer-vision analytics. High-speed cameras collect synchronized footage when an athlete steps onto the board and stop capture automatically when the athlete exits the water. AI services then classify and organize the clips and return them to coaches on tablets for immediate review. The system goes beyond conventional replay by applying 3D vision and deep neural networks to reconstruct the diver's body posture in three dimensions, estimate joint angles, and quantify key movements so coaches can diagnose the root causes of bad entries or weak takeoff. It also reconstructs the venue in 3D, extracts key actions, supports 360-degree free-angle replay, and automatically identifies dive types, difficulty coefficients, and scoring cues. That turns raw training video into a searchable, measurable coaching asset instead of an archive of unstructured footage.

solution_components.name: High-speed Video Capture System
solution_components.role: Collects synchronized diving footage automatically when athletes begin and complete training actions.

solution_components.name: AI Middle Platform Solution
solution_components.role: Organizes captured clips and supports analysis workflows that return training feedback to coaches rapidly.

solution_components.name: 3D Vision Pose Estimation
solution_components.role: Reconstructs athletes' body posture in three dimensions and measures movement quality through joint-angle analysis.

solution_components.name: Enterprise Knowledge Middle Platform Solution
solution_components.role: Helps turn elite training data into reusable knowledge models for coaching and future athlete development.

data_flow: Training video is captured automatically by high-speed cameras, then passed into AI classification and clip-organization workflows that deliver results to coach tablets. Selected clips are reconstructed into 3D motion models, scored, and stored as reusable knowledge assets so coaches can compare posture, diagnose errors, and refine athlete guidance.
business_outcome: The diving team gained faster video review, more objective movement analysis, and a way to turn champion-level performance data into repeatable coaching knowledge and richer fan-facing content possibilities.
architecture_clues: The system uses a cloud-edge-device architecture rather than uploading all raw training footage into a purely centralized pipeline.
3D venue reconstruction and 360-degree replay are core parts of the solution, not just downstream visualizations.
Automatic action identification links each clip to dive codes and difficulty coefficients for structured analysis.
evidence_quotes: Baidu became the exclusive AI partner of the China National Diving Team and built the country's first '3D + AI' diving training system (original: 百度智能云正式成为中国国家跳水队独家AI合作伙伴，打造的国内首个"3D+AI"跳水训练系统).

The system uses a cloud-edge-device integrated hardware and software setup with high-speed video capture, intelligent video organization, and encrypted data handling (original: 搭建了"云-边-端"一体的软硬件系统，核心算法包括高速视频智能采集、视频数据智能整理以及数据的安全加密).
3D vision and deep neural networks estimate athletes' three-dimensional posture and joint angles to evaluate technique quantitatively (original: 利用3D视觉技术和深度神经网络估算运动员三维的姿态，获得每个关节的三维角度).
The system can automatically identify dive actions, codes, difficulty coefficients, and scoring quality (original: 能够自动识别出是哪一个动作、对应的动作代码、难度系数，并对完成质量进行评分).
